svg.title: Separate research dates from ancient ages
svg.desc: Top: research milestones at Tabon in 1962 to 1965 and the Homo luzonensis description in 2019. Bottom: fictional age ranges A from 1000 to 2000 and B from 1500 to 2500 years ago overlap from 1500 to 2000. These fictional ranges are not Tabon or Callao ages.

g.text: Separate research dates from ancient ages
RESEARCH HISTORY: modern study, not ancient lifetimes
FICTIONAL RANGE PRACTICE: not dates for the two sites
Overlap means the exact older-younger order is uncertain.
Teaching summaries and models, not photographs of original finds.
